while i do think the market has already priced in for a potential rate hike later, this upside move at the open gives the post-FOMC reaction more room for a higher-probability downside move.

a gap down open or a green to red intraday move pre-FOMC was the opportunity i am looking to get in for a higher probability ''relief rally''. while market could still rallied later post FOMC, i feel the odds now is almost 50-50 without any edges.

Educational Thread Using Current 
$XLRE
 (Rates Sensitive Sector) - Higher Win Rate Odds If It Killed Off The Conventional Hammer, First  

Yesterday's print closed with a bullish hammer at 200-MA. It's a conventional ''buy on confirmation'' technical idea but I actually thought if market could open lower, kill off this ''bullish hammer'', the odds of a upside is even much higher if it does a intraday r2g for a lowered hammer re-print.  

Mean reversion ideas taken at a much lower pull than conventional spot has greater probability, especially when it happens after flushing out the first group of buyers immediately. this are the kind of small nuances in my thought process to increase my win rate %.   

if we always taking a mean reversion hammer trade on technical basis without consideration of the situational awareness, the win rate % at best is only 35%. almost breaking even even if u have a 2:1 reward to risk on T+3 with 3 stop strategy.
